meta.name: Sync Notion knowledge base with Vapi assistants and Pinecone using OpenAI

name: Notion → Pinecone + Vapi Knowledge Base Sync

parameters.content:
## Notion → Pinecone + Vapi Knowledge Base Sync

### How it works

This workflow runs daily to synchronize structured Notion content into both Pinecone and a Vapi knowledge base. It clears the existing Pinecone vectors, pulls multiple Notion content sources, merges and tags them, then indexes the documents with OpenAI embeddings. In parallel, it builds language-specific Vapi knowledge base files, replaces the old files, creates query tools, and updates the relevant Vapi assistants.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger time and timezone for the desired daily sync window.
- Add Notion credentials and point each Notion node to the correct Services, FAQ, Qualification Script, Dialogue Tree, Objection Handling, and Disclaimers databases or pages.
- Configure Pinecone credentials, index host URL, namespace, and any deletion/upsert settings so the clear and upsert nodes target the same index.
- Configure OpenAI credentials and ensure the embedding model dimensions match the Pinecone index configuration.
- Add Vapi API credentials or headers, and set the old file IDs, assistant IDs, and tool/assistant payload fields used by the Vapi HTTP request and code nodes.
- Review the code nodes for expected field names, language mappings, file names, metadata tags, and any hardcoded IDs before enabling the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust the Notion source nodes, tagging logic, text chunk size, embedding model, Pinecone namespace, and Vapi language/file mappings to match different knowledge base structures or additional languages.

## Schedule and reset index

Starts the daily sync at 2:00 AM, clears existing Pinecone vectors, and waits briefly so deletion completes before new content is fetched.

## Upper Notion sources

Fetches the upper cluster of Notion content sources: services, FAQs, and the qualification script.

## Lower Notion sources

Fetches the lower cluster of Notion content sources: dialogue tree, objection handling, and disclaimers.

## Merge and tag content

Combines all Notion results into a unified dataset and applies content tags or metadata before branching to Pinecone indexing and Vapi file generation.

## Pinecone indexing stack

Chunks merged documents, loads them for vector ingestion, generates OpenAI embeddings, and upserts the resulting vectors into Pinecone.

## Pinecone completion log

Records that the Pinecone document sync branch has completed successfully.

## Build Vapi files

Transforms the merged content into language-specific knowledge base files for Vapi.

## Replace Vapi file

Deletes the old Vapi knowledge base file, prepares the newly generated file content, uploads it to Vapi, and extracts the new file ID from the upload response.

## Create Vapi query tool

Creates a new Vapi query tool that references the freshly uploaded knowledge base file.

## Update Vapi assistant

Retrieves the current Vapi assistant, builds an update payload with the new tool configuration, patches the assistant, and logs completion for both language variants.
